Recent Wall Street coverage has kept Lumentum in focus, with the company appearing in multiple top analyst call roundups and fresh commentary suggesting 2027 could be a pivotal year for the optical and photonics company, likely tied to AI infrastructure and datacom demand. With 27 analysts aligned on a strong buy consensus and the stock still well below their collective target, investors tracking LITE are watching whether today's pullback is noise or the start of a retest of lower support around the $940 range seen earlier in the session.
